canonical_name: Banach open mapping theorem over real and complex Banach spaces
literal_source_claim_zh: 满射有界线性算子是开映射
literal_source_claim_en: A surjective bounded linear operator is an open map.
source_attribution: Stefan Banach, 1929 (catalog metadata only; not a source citation)
canonical_statement: For both real and complex scalars, every surjective bounded linear operator between Banach spaces is an open map.
canonical_claim: Closed conjunction of the ordinary same-field Real and Complex Banach open mapping propositions.
